concerns.text: The interpretability phase correlates PCs with thermal conductivity, sound velocity, and first ionization energy, but no source for this elemental-property lookup table is named anywhere (plan, research, or data-model). Unlike the main dataset, this resource is NOT flagged as unavailable and NOT covered by the data contract. Name the intended source (e.g. pymatgen's periodic-table data, a specific open elemental-properties table) or add it to the gated/limitations list so it cannot silently become an invented table at implementation time.
